title: The Fall of Babylon

questions.question: After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven, having great authority, and the earth was made bright with his ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:1 (ESV): "After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven, having great authority, and the earth was made bright with his glory."

questions.question: And he called out with a mighty voice, "Fallen, fallen is Babylon the ____! She has become a dwelling place for demons..."
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:2 (ESV): "And he called out with a mighty voice, 'Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a dwelling place for demons, a haunt for every unclean spirit, a haunt for every unclean bird, a haunt for every unclean and despicable beast.'"

questions.question: For all nations have drunk the wine of the passion of her sexual immorality, and the kings of the earth have committed immorality with her, and the ____ of the earth have grown rich from the power of her luxurious living.
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:3 (ESV): "For all nations have drunk the wine of the passion of her sexual immorality, and the kings of the earth have committed immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown rich from the power of her luxurious living."

questions.question: Then I heard another voice from heaven saying, "____ her, my people, lest you take part in her sins, lest you share in her plagues;"
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:4 (ESV): "Then I heard another voice from heaven saying, 'Come out of her, my people, lest you take part in her sins, lest you share in her plagues;'"

questions.question: for her sins are heaped high as ____, and God has remembered her iniquities.
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:5 (ESV): "for her sins are heaped high as heaven, and God has remembered her iniquities."

questions.question: Pay her back as she herself has paid back others, and repay her ____ for her deeds; mix a ____ portion for her in the cup she mixed.
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:6 (ESV): "Pay her back as she herself has paid back others, and repay her double for her deeds; mix a double portion for her in the cup she mixed."

questions.question: For this reason her plagues will come in a single ____—death and mourning and famine—and she will be burned up with fire; for mighty is the Lord God who has judged her.
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:8 (ESV): "For this reason her plagues will come in a single day—death and mourning and famine—and she will be burned up with fire; for mighty is the Lord God who has judged her."

questions.question: And the kings of the earth... will weep and wail over her when they see the smoke of her burning. They will stand far off, in fear of her torment, and say, "Alas! Alas! You great city, you mighty city, Babylon! For in a single ____ your judgment has come."
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:9-10 (ESV): "...They will stand far off, in fear of her torment, and say, 'Alas! Alas! You great city, you mighty city, Babylon! For in a single hour your judgment has come.'"

questions.question: And the merchants of the earth weep and mourn for her, since no one buys their ____ anymore,
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:11 (ESV): "And the merchants of the earth weep and mourn for her, since no one buys their cargo anymore,"

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT listed among the cargo items of the merchants in Revelation 18?
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:12 records "cargo of gold, silver, jewels, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, all kinds of scented wood, all kinds of articles of ivory, all kinds of articles of costly wood, bronze, iron and marble". *Correction: Iron IS listed.* Wait, what is not listed? Let me check the exact wording. Verse 13: "cinnamon, spice, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle and sheep, horses and chariots, and slaves, that is, human souls." The options provided are mostly all there. Let me re-read the options. Ah, they actually ARE all there. Let me pick a better distractor: "Cotton"

questions.question: And all shipmasters and seafaring men, sailors and all whose trade is on the ____, stood far off and cried out as they saw the smoke of her burning, "What city was like the great city?"
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:17-18 (ESV): "And all shipmasters and seafaring men, sailors and all whose trade is on the sea, stood far off and cried out as they saw the smoke of her burning, 'What city was like the great city?'"

questions.question: Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, for God has given ____ for you against her!
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:20 (ESV): "Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, for God has given judgment for you against her!"

questions.question: Then a mighty angel took up a stone like a great ____ and threw it into the sea, saying, "So will Babylon the great city be thrown down with violence, and will be found no more;"
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:21 (ESV): "Then a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and threw it into the sea, saying, 'So will Babylon the great city be thrown down with violence, and will be found no more;'"

questions.question: "and the sound of harpists and musicians, of flute players and trumpeters, will be heard in you no more... and the light of a ____ will shine in you no more,"
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:22-23 (ESV): "and the sound of harpists and musicians, of flute players and trumpeters, will be heard in you no more... and the light of a lamp will shine in you no more, and the voice of bridegroom and bride will be heard in you no more,"

questions.question: And in her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been ____ on earth.
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:24 (ESV): "And in her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on earth."

key_verse_text: Then I heard another voice from heaven saying, "Come out of her, my people, lest you take part in her sins, lest you share in her plagues;"
